
# Percent Green


Let's first see what geographic levels this variables is available for
```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

ds = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/salurbal_BEC__v2/salurbal_BEC__v2.parquet" |> 
   arrow::open_dataset() 

df_data = ds |> 
    select(iso2, geo,BECGSPCT) |> 
    filter(!is.na(BECGSPCT)) |> 
    collect()

df_data |> 
    count(geo, iso2)
```

# Education variables

We want to pull CNSMINPR_L2 from SALURBAL and see waht geographic levels avialable and get data. 


```{r}

library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)


ds = "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/salurbal_SEC_Census__v1/salurbal_SEC_Census__v1.parquet" |> 
   arrow::open_dataset() 

df_pct_primary = ds |>
   select(iso2, geo, salid, year, CNSMINPR) %>% 
   collect() %>% 
   filter(!is.na(CNSMINPR))

glimpse(df_pct_primary)
```

Now lets see what geo levels acvailable for country.

```{r}
df_pct_primary |> 
    count(geo, iso2, year) |> 
    arrange(iso2)
```
